# CrazyCook

> Static restaurant website template for demonstration and client presentation. It is not a live restaurant or ordering service.

## Project
CrazyCook is a single-page restaurant website template built with HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript.

## Demo
https://sudomarc.github.io/CrazyCook/

## Sections in the public demo
- Hero / presentation
- Story
- Menu
- Gallery
- FAQ
- Contact
- Cart and simulated checkout flow

## Editorial and functional limitations
- CrazyCook is a template demonstration, not a verified restaurant business.
- No genuine customer testimonials, review scores, customer counts, current orders or sales figures are published as verified facts.
- The checkout flow is simulated; real orders and payments are not enabled.
- Address, telephone, opening hours, prices and social profiles must be supplied and verified by the template operator before a client deployment.
- The site does not make claims about a real restaurant location, current availability or delivery coverage.

## Customization
Replace TODO_* values in `site.config.json` with verified restaurant information before adapting the template for a real business. Review all content and remove sample material that is not supported by evidence.
